Get ready to dance all night at Groove & Glow Bolly Disco Dandiya—where beats meet bright lights and fun!

About this Event

Get Ready for Groove & Glow Bolly Disco Dandiya!Join us for a night full of dandiya beats, disco vibes, and Bolly magic all in person! It's the perfect chance to show off your moves, light up the dance floor, and have a blast with friends. Whether you're a dandiya pro or just love to dance, this event's got you covered. Bring your energy, your glow sticks, and let's make it a night to remember!
